hooks.command: [ -d "$HOME/Documents/Notes" ] || exit 0; printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"The plan was just approved. Offer to save it to the Obsidian vault using the obsidian-plan skill: it belongs on an existing task or workstream as status draft or todo, never as a separate plan note. Apply the sizing rule first - trivial work does not warrant a note.\"}}"

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // \"\""); case "$f" in */memory/*) [ "${f##*/}" = "MEMORY.md" ] || printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"About to write auto-memory. Decide where this belongs before writing. Anything that should hold on every machine - working preferences, conventions, workflow rules - belongs in the chezmoi source at ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_config/agent/ followed by chezmoi apply: AGENTS.md for general preferences, an existing skill when it qualifies that skill behaviour, or a new skill for a distinct workflow. Auto-memory is machine-local and will not reach another workstation. Keep it here only when it is specific to this project on this machine. State which you chose."}}';; esac
